title: +*TECHNICAL WRITING
description: Introduces students to producing instructive, informative, and persuasive technical/professional documents aimed at well-defined and achievable outcomes. Focuses on presenting information using rhetorically appropriate style, design, vocabulary, structure, and visuals. Gathers, reads, and analyzes information and learns a variety of strategies for producing accessible, usable, reader-centered deliverable documents that are clear, concise, and ethical.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: WR 121Z, 121HZ, 121, 121H or minimum score of 1 in 'Exam for Waiver - WR 121'.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WR 121Z, WR 121HZ, WR 121 and WR 121H.
attribute_description:
• Bacc Core, Skills – Writing II (CSW2)
  • Core Education - Writing Elevation (CSWE)
books_html: No-cost: Course utilizes open educational resources, materials available through the library, or does not require any purchased materials.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component. This section meets 75% in-person and 25% asynchronously online. No second week adds.
